ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Blue and Gold: Blue Beetle is best friends with Booster Gold, and their shared misadventures and sense of humor are notorious. Legacy: After he was injured saving Ted Kord’s life, the dying wish of the first Blue Beetle (Dan Garrett) was that Kord carry on and continue his battle against evil. Kord’s adventuring as the Blue Beetle is a never-ending effort to live up to the name and wishes of his predecessor.
